resolution: Generation 1 closes the deterministic hardware-independent PerceptionWorldBridge validation core at bounded repository-hosted component-CI scope. It establishes typed percept candidate envelopes, exact permission/source/bridge-generation fences, transfer-time REMOTE_FRAME revalidation, dispatch-time EXTERNAL_VLM revalidation, non-replayable expired intents, same-clock freshness rejection and explicit cross-clock UNALIGNED handling without false monotonic arithmetic. It performs no actual bridge/network/provider/VLM/device execution and cannot mutate canonical world truth or authorize effects/completion.
next_exact_action: Continue the canonical Perception Fabric frontier without duplicating WP712. The next dependency-correct unclaimed package is the dashboard capability/audit plane or the sustained multi-source acceptance harness once WP708/WP710/WP711 dependencies reconcile. Final local integration must bind real bridge/device/permission adapters and prove disconnect/reconnect plus revocation behavior before any runtime credit.
